column3: # Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled
# Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
# Application Error Disclosure (ignore for static sites)
# Storable and Cacheable Content (acceptable for static sites)
# Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments (acceptable for Hugo sites)
# Incomplete or No Cache-control and Pragma HTTP Header Set (acceptable for static content)
# Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion (common for CDN usage)
# Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages (not applicable to static sites)
# Secure Pages Include Mixed Content (if using HTTPS CDN resources)
# Missing Anti-clickjacking Header (covered by X-Frame-Options check)
# Timestamp Disclosure - Unix (not sensitive for static sites)
# Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens (not applicable to static sites)
